name: List Scheduled Events
description: List the caller's pending scheduled events, soonest first. Each entry carries its handle, operation reference, next fire time and effective tracking; a recurring event also carries its repeat spec, lastFired time and — when tracked — the lastJob ID of its most recent fire (read that Job for the outcome).

events.description: Pending events, each as {handle, op, time, track, repeat?, lastFired?, lastJob?}, ordered by next fire time
